Page 76 Cont.
Sept. 20 Doris Cushman - 13 - of Flushing L. I. operated on for apendicitis not apendix had 108 fever, was Enrolled a week To-day when hopeless. Following Monday letter informs fever down to 100 hope.
Sept. 21 Henry Doolittle - 55 - losing property - has paid $2400.00 only 1600 more to pay .... has lost his hearing almost.
Della Rank - 5140 Casmier - N. Det. trying to go on farm - has farm in view - phone To. 6-3751
Suzanne Georgen - 8 - non cath. operation This a.m. on brain after knocked down by two cars
Stasia Simpson -59 - nerveous
Anna Otto - 43 - Severe pain in eye 22 yrs.
John F. Hughes - 53 - hearing seriously threatened and job & family depending on that (hearing)
22 John Wolfe - 58 of Dubuque, Iowa - neck broken & fractured scull in auto ac. has large family - wife dead ....
Page 77 Sept 22nd Jenie Wingle - 45 - very peculiarly nerveous ...
23 Antoinette Mrs. Kelly - 40 - fears cancer of stomach .... has family and unable to have operation.
28 Sam Scola - 23 - nerveous break - away from confession for years now in Hosp ....
Frank Paul Maniaci - 54 - Gambling - Excellant man only this.
24 Esther Bougher - 61 - nerveous ....
Abram Bougher - 66 - stomach & Vericose ulcers
26 11:05 P.M. Donald Orlowski - 3'2 - ruptured apendix. .. . hopeless .... enrolled To-night
27 Virginia Koss - 14 - . . . Spells at night ....
Mrs. Josephine Hughes - 42 - operation To-day.
